The '''Fath system''',<ref name="TCWNP" /> also known as the '''JanFathal system''',<ref name="TEA" /> was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Fath sector/Legends|Fath sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Its main [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was [[JanFathal]],<ref name="TCWNP" /> which became a member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TEA" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] sent a task force to the Fath system to capture JanFathal.
